notes.title: Patch 1.1 Hotfix, New Teaser for Episode 2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/3ca97e9942c01df188d1eb744eb8d410bcd3fcca.png"]

A Hotfix for Patch 1.1 is now live for all players. This latest update includes a variety of minor fixes and improvements.



We've also recently unveiled the latest teaser for of the Devil - Episode 2: a sneak-peek of the episode's new title screen and confirmation that Episode 2 will be available in 2025!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/3c5ba32ca947effffed1b95d59f18d84b1d8ab0a.png"]

Don't forget to follow us on all our socials and join our Discord to make sure you never miss an update or teaser or what's to come!



Twitter | Tumblr | Bluesky | Discord





  
Patch Notes for of the Devil Ver. 1.1 Hotfix

Settings/Accessibility
Added an option to prevent controls from being displayed.

Dropdown found in Settings->Gameplay->Displayed Controls

Setting "Displayed Controls" to "Hide Control Glyphs" will prevent tooltips and other UI elements from displaying controls regardless of whether or not you are using mouse, keyboard, or a gamepad to play.

Fixed an issue where the "Minimum High Pitch Ambient SFX" setting could mute additional, unrelated sound effects under certain circumstances.

SFX and BGM will now fade-in to appropriate levels upon loading a save instead of starting to play at normal volume mid-loading screen.

Fixed an issue where the set value for "Phone Opacity" was being unintentionally reset when changing one's phone colors.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/314a7b667fdfd8ef403bf37d48dd0ddd92881daf.png"]




Bugs & Other Miscellaneous Fixes
Fixed an issue where saves made at specific points could fail to load properly, leading to freezes.

Fixed an issue where certain in-game settings could fail to initialize improperly, leading to freezes.

Fixed an issue where it was possible to drag cards with the mouse during moments when cards should be selected as soon as left-mouse is clicked down.

Fixed an issue where the "Store" menu in the phone could scroll back to the top whenever certain UI items were interacted with using the mouse.

Fixed an issue where gamepad navigation between Backlog messages could behave improperly after moving from one save to another.

Fixed an issue where the wrong controls could be displayed when navigating to and from confirmation windows and the pause menu.

Reduced brightness in certain 3D backgrounds.

 

As always, you can report bugs or request assistance from us on our official Discord.



Don't forget to Wishlist Episode 2, coming soon!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124590/of_the_Devil__Episode_2/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Full Controller Support & Accessibility Features
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/51c916d14fd841800ad0c5d536495c0db5e179fe.gif"]

Patch 1.1 is here, bringing full controller support, a range of accessibility features, and various improvements to UI and quality of life across the board!



We're also excited to announce that...


of the Devil is coming to PLAY NYC @ ANIME NYC! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/6255fdc9d1c728e780f54d3aa650ef18c1412158.jpg"]

Stop by Hall 1B August 22nd-24th to try out our new demo, take a photo with Morgan and Serra, and grab sticker sheets and phone charms from our merch table!  #PlayNYC2025



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/6b07589ddf96599834dab2de75aed4618d271e48.jpg"]



Keep reading for additional details about everything new we've added to of the Devil in the official Patch Notes for our biggest set of improvements to-date!





  
Patch Notes for of the Devil ver. 1.1



Controls
Added controller recognition and support for DualShock, Xbox, Steam Deck, Switch and Generic gamepads for all gameplay.

A keyboard is still required to enter passwords at two points in Episode 1.

Added support for playing the game with WASD/Arrow Keys and Keyboard rather than Mouse and Keyboard.

Added glyphs in the bottom-right corner that display controls for the most recently used device (e.g. Dualshock).

Added glyphs to various UI elements that display context-sensitive controls for the most recently used device (e.g. Delete selected save slot).

Controls for zooming in and moving unlocked images in the concept gallery have been re-worked across the board (Players no longer need to right click to drag).

Controls for Investigating environments have been re-worked across the board (Mouse or reticle movement close to the center of the screen will not prompt the camera to move).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/822308c23610411031cb0cf00b7afb460f5c90b7.png"]
 Settings/Accessibility
Added an option to switch to Dyslexic and low-vision friendly fonts

Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Fonts.

Affects the fonts used for most text that appears in game. Visual variety of text encountered will be greatly reduced.

Added an option to switch to Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia color modes.

Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Color Mode.

Algorithmically adjusts the colors used in key UI elements to improve readability for those with the setting's listed type of color-blindness.

Added an option to double the duration given for time-sensitive gameplay sections or remove time-limits entirely.

Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Time-Sensitive Choices.

Affects the time between witness statements in Objection gameplay. If time-limits are removed, witness statements will no longer proceed automatically during Objection gameplay.

Affects the time allowed for choosing a card after CALL-ing on a witness statement during Objection gameplay. If time-limits are removed, no duration indicators will appear.

Added an option to minimize non-essential camera motion.

Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Camera Motion.

Prevents small, looping animations from affecting cameras.

Prevents the camera from being shaken.

Skips over fast-motion-blurred camera-swivel animations inside the courtroom.

Added an option to minimize high-pitch "ringing" looped sound effects.

Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->High Pitch Ambient SFX.

Mutes a number of looped sound effects. Auditory ambience will be impacted.

Added an option to minimize "glitching" visual effects in Accessibility->"Glitch" VFX.

Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->"Glitch" VFX.

Disables a variety of "Glitch" post-processing effects. Visual variety will be impacted.

Added an option to "lock" displayed controls to a specific type of controller.

Dropdown found in Settings->Gameplay->Displayed Controls.

If of the Devil will always display the controls for the selected device regardless of what other device you make inputs with if "Displayed Controls" is not set to "Automatic."



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/f452d2f95736f3964a3d230c5e45f7c8a3787276.png"]



Note that none of the accessibility options listed above are overridden by enabling Highroller mode.

As a reminder, Highroller affects the following:

Players are limited to one save slot.

Players cannot load saves from the phone menu during courtroom gameplay.

Players cannot quick-save.

Auto-saves will not occur.

Maximum Ante will be higher in every section Ante is available.

The maximum Blind you can reach during courtroom gameplay will double.

Highroller can be disabled at any time, but can only be enabled at the start of an Episode.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/6fd14285cfe8b7d732f6e38c8d3c9d4416a2a2b9.png"]


Gameplay
Added an Insight mechanic to Objection segments.

Hovering the mouse over or selecting the CALL button with gamepad will now highlight certain words in a witness' statement in red.

These words are intended to highlight the specific "objectionable" information in a witness' statement that one of your three cards might contradict.

This feature can be disabled in Settings->Gameplay->Testimony Insight.

Added the ability to return the last card placed on the timeline to hand using "Return" input during Timeline gameplay (Right-Mouse click by default).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/3197e3aa15134e40ed17ab352cc26467508c55fe.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/af3d752d68fa51763ed956fd43d0044d9a38fa22.png"]




Changes to UI
Adjusted UI visuals for various menus to better provide feedback of when an item is selected, "pressed" or de-selected with either mouse or gamepad.

Adjusted the dialogue text box to leave room in bottom right corner for control glyphs.

Adjusted visuals for Timeline gameplay.

Collected Profiles, Articles, Terms and Evidence will now be automatically sorted in phone menus.. 

Unread items will appear at the top of the list, sorted alphabetically.

Previously read items will follow, sorted alphabetically.

Added a button for returning to Title Screen to the phone's "Main Menu."



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/276a6d3d4654ba6acaea1a46e06cd64f583e7533.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/8d501d0fbe8c37b938fc0dfa7cfb71b90d23533e.png"]
Bugs & Other Miscellaneous Fixes
Fixed an issue where certain specific UI elements were not scaling properly at ultra-wide resolutions.

Fixed an issue where opacity of the Phone UI was not always responding correctly to adjusted settings.

Fixed an issue where saves made at certain parts of courtroom sections could record data improperly.

Adjusted the layering of the Ante UI so Card details no longer can be obscured by Ante meter/fire visuals.



 

Thank you to everyone who participated in the Beta for this patch. 

As always, you can report bugs or request assistance from us on our official Discord.



Don't forget to Wishlist Episode 2, coming soon!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124590/of_the_Devil__Episode_2/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Controller Support Beta Release
notes.notes:
of the Devil debuts its first open beta!


As we first debuted at TooManyGames 2025, we've prepared a new build of of the Devil that fully supports a wide variety of controller types, intended to allow players to enjoy of the Devil whether they're playing on the couch, in bed, at their desk, or on their Steam Deck.



This build also includes our biggest accessibility patch to date, adding a variety of new Settings so players can have the most comfortable experience possible.



Because of the amount of work that's gone into this patch, and because of the variety of player circumstances it's intended to address, we're launching this new build first as a limited-time open beta for players to opt-into at their discretion.



We'll use player feedback from this beta period to smooth over any growing pains and improve quality of life before pushing out controller support to all players.


"How do I join the beta?"


If you're interesting in joining the beta: Thank you!  



First, make sure you're a member of the official Nth Circle discord with the Bug Squasher Role. You can receive this role by entering the #pick-a-role channel and clicking the button that reads "I want to submit a bug!"



You'll then be able to view channels that will provide instructions on exactly how you'll need to configure of the Devil on Steam in order to join the beta.



Keep reading below for an overview of the improvements, adjustments, and brand new quality of life features that we're excited to bring to all of you!



Note: Visuals, controls, and content not final. Various aspects may change before exiting Beta.

notes.title: Patch 1.07 - Steam Deck Verified
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/51c916d14fd841800ad0c5d536495c0db5e179fe.gif

Patch 1.07 brings a number variety of fixes, and adjustments to our settings and UI, earning of the Devil its status as officially Steam Deck Verified!

Read below for additional details on what's new in 1.07 and for an update on player-requested Steam Trading Card Items, including Emoticons.

Patch Notes

Gameplay:

 Fixed an issue where Tutorials were not being provided during Episode 0 under certain circumstances.


Scripting:

Addressed a variety of grammar and spelling errors.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/4642444e34499e1042d9b0332823c64af97c9b14.png

UI and Display:

 Added a prompt prior to the title screen to automatically use our Recommended Settings for Steam Deck.
 Increased the size of the Settings Menu and its items on the title screen and during gameplay.
 Increased the size of the Continue Menu and its items on the title screen.
 Increased the space dedicated to, and font size of, "Definitions" seen when viewing in-game Terms on your phone.
 Added a Settings option to Invert Y-Axis when moving the camera during Investigations.
 Added a Settings option to Turn off Credit Gain/Loss animations (numbers will still be displayed in top left of UI).
 Removed references to mouse and keyboard controls/glyphs when playing on Steam Deck.
 Removed the ability to set the game Resolution to any aspect ratios that might result in graphical display issues.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/e46d528d21bfcf0519856a4fd4fae705891180d9.png

Improvements and Quality of Life features we're looking into for future patches:

 Full controller support for easier menu navigation and smoother gameplay experience.
 Accessibility features that adjust the font(s) used in-game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/86b6fa317dd213b6353b264aaaa23ec2ab32004a.png


About Steam Trading Card Items

Thank you all for your passion and excitement about of the Devil. It means the world that so many of you have asked for a way to show off your love for of the Devil through the Steam Trading Card system.

Games that are free to download on Steam cannot have Steam Trading Cards drop randomly based on time spent in-game.

Because of the Devil is free to download, allowing anyone to play through the entirety of Episode 0 before deciding to unlock additional episodes, we cannot have Steam Trading Cards drop randomly over the course of normal gameplay; we would need to tie Steam Trading Card drops to some form of microtransaction. Without Steam Trading Cards, players cannot craft badges to unlock Profile Backgrounds or Emoticons either.

We do not intend to add microtransactions to of the Devil in the foreseeable future, meaning of the Devil will not have Steam Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds or Emoticons for the foreseeable future either.



Thank you for Reading!


As always, thank you all for playing, thank you for providing feedback, and thank you for spreading the word! Don't forget to Wishlist Episode 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124590/of_the_Devil__Episode_2/

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/9b3c013cb4b86d9ff6e7accf62c37157d95bcd66.gif

Patch 1.06 is here with a variety of fixes, corrections, and adjustments. We've also got an update on:

Merch!
Over 700(!) of you filled out our merch interest survey, and thanks to that we’re happy to announce that we’ve started to work on exactly what you’ve asked for, loud and clear:

Acrylic Charms!

Stay tuned in the coming weeks for updates about specifications, availability and where you’ll be able to purchase them.

Our team’s focus remains firmly on releasing Episodes 2-5 as quickly and in as high-quality a state as possible, but if the charms go well, we’ll be able to look at producing a greater variety of merchandise for of the Devil.



Patch Notes

Optimization and Performance

 Compressed the size (in memory) of some outlier sprites and textures.


Gameplay:

 Fixed an issue where the Enter/Return key could be used to choose the first available choice.
 Adjusted the description for, and the dialogue surrounding the introduction of, a key piece of evidence during the crime scene investigation in Episode 1.
 Added a failsafe that will award the Episode 1 Highroller Exclusive Charm on Startup if the player has the “Cutthroat Industry” Achievement but the charm had previously failed to unlock properly.
 Fixed an issue where the game may have waited for additional input in between choosing to CALL on a line of dialogue and displaying the cards you have to choose from.


Scripting:

 Addressed a variety of grammar and spelling errors.
 Fixed an issue where the wrong name for an item


UI and Display:

 Fixed an issue where the cost to unlock the Rose Gold phone case color was listed as 5 instead of 20.
 Fixed an issue where the total possible evidence collected in Episode 1 could be summed incorrectly (Display Issue Only).
 Fixed an issue where certain elements of the UI could animate incorrectly when viewing Evidence or Profiles.
 Fixed an issue where certain elements of the Phone could clip into UI elements unintentionally while viewing Evidence or Profiles.
 Fixed an issue where the Dialogue textbox visibility could fail to change properly when switching between the Phone Menu, the Backlog, and normal gameplay.
 Reduced the length of helper text on certain choice Cards to improve readability.
 Fixed an issue where the “Court is in session” reminder text preventing players from loading a save while in the courtroom could be seen on a Highroller save while playing on a non-highroller save under certain circumstances.


Environments:

 Adjusted the brightness of the Court Lobby at different times of day.
 Fixed an issue where certain 3D objects in the courtroom were clipping unintentionally.
 Fixed an issue where certain animated elements in the courtroom were looping improperly.


Improvements and Quality of Life features we're looking into for future patches:

 Additional keyboard shortcuts for navigating to Evidence, Profiles, Settings, etc.
 More robust support for Steam Deck and other controller setups.
 Accessibility features that adjust the font(s) used in-game.




As always, thank you all for playing, thank you for providing feedback, and thank you for spreading the word! Don't forget to wishlist Episode 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124590/of_the_Devil__Episode_2/

notes.title: Patch 1.05: Optimization!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/98073d6c24a1fa97213a3dd0fcee24491c921ded.gif

Patch 1.05 is here! In addition to a handful of fixes, corrections, and quality of life features, we’re excited to announce that we’ve also made additions that should improve performance and optimization across a variety of player setups!

If you’re curious about what’s new in Patch 1.05:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/22961467b411ec0ea8d2ed1672d259c7aff510e3.png

of the Devil no longer restricts the list of resolutions you can choose from- you’re free to select any resolution that your monitor supports. Please note that choosing a resolution listed in red is not recommended as it may result in small presentation issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/d4c15775b2c5f4e355e035cebf2a24f8db5ecd3f.png

of the Devil has a new feature in the Settings menu that allows you to select a Frames-per-Second number to target. If you’re playing on an older computer, running on a battery, or just more interested in fidelity than framerate, you can set it to 30 FPS for longer battery life (and more quiet PC fans) or even as low as 24 FPS for a more “cinematic” feel.

You can also set the FPS target to try and always match your monitor’s refresh rate, or you can choose to play with your framerate entirely uncapped, but these options are recommended only for higher spec machines.


Optimization and Performance

 Significantly reduced memory usage on start up, reducing the time it takes for the game to boot up.
 Significantly reduced the average and maximum memory usage in-game, reducing the risk of crashes and improving performance on computers with less available RAM.
 Added a Target FPS dropdown to settings and set of the Devil’s default target FPS to no greater than 60.


Gameplay:

 Fixed an issue where certain choice cards and evidence items weren’t matching their display names 1:1.
 Adjusted minor contextual hinting during Trial 1-1.
 Adjusted contextual hinting during investigation to illustrate that codes may be alphanumeric/
 Added failsafes to attempt to award Demo-based bonuses if the Demo has already been uninstalled.


Scripting:

 Addressed a variety of grammar and spelling errors.


UI and Display:

 Fixed an issue where the incorrect resolution value could be displayed upon starting the game and opening Settings for the first time.
 Fixed an issue where text reveal speed set in Settings was resetting to default value at improper times.
 Fixed an issue where Wager choices could fail to scale up properly if the game was being Skipped through at a high enough speed.
 Fixed an issue where screen elements in the background of the Courtroom could fail to animate properly.
 Reduced the intensity of camera bobbing inside the Courtroom.
 Fixed an issue where charms’ reflections were being lit improperly based on certain backgrounds being loaded.
 Fixed an issue where the Dialogue textbox would display text improperly for the duration of its dismissal animation.
 Fixed an issue where certain choice cards could be dragged and dropped at inappropriate times.
 Fixed an issue where Dialogue could display instantly due to certain player input in Objection segments.
 Fixed an issue where Investigation camera movement wouldn’t always freeze while the game is paused.
 Fixed an issue where Settings wouldn’t display the proper values on the in-game phone if adjusted from the title screen or vice-versa.
 Fixed an issue where certain UI elements and unlockable concept art would appear at the wrong resolution on certain graphics quality settings.
 Fixed an issue where the phone wouldn’t always have the proper case color during texting conversations.
 Fixed an issue where the backlog could be viewed on the title screen.


Improvements and Quality of Life features we're looking into for future patches:

 Additional keyboard shortcuts for navigating to Evidence, Profiles, Settings, etc.
 More robust support for Steam Deck and other controller setups.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04.2.15.2025.1
notes.notes:
Our latest hotfix is here! This update includes the following changes and fixes:

Gameplay:

 Added fallbacks to prevent game freezes when loading saves made in specific script locations on prior versions of the game.
 Fixed an issue where certain 3D environments appeared far too bright on lower graphics quality settings.


Scripting:

 Addressed an issue where Serra could stare at you during a certain game over scenario.
 Addressed a variety of grammar and spelling errors.


UI and Display:

 Profiles, terms, evidence and articles in inventory now fully reset upon returning to Title menu.
 Auto-advance can no longer be activated while the game is paused.
 Fixed an issue where certain phone case colors were not preserved properly upon restarting the game.
 Added an icon to the textbox that indicates when Auto-advance is activate.
 Changed the revolver sprite in the top left to be red while playing in Highroller mode.
 Scene introductory "Typewriter" text now finishes properly while in Auto-advance mode.
 Fixed an issue where scrolling text on the screens in the courtroom failed to animate under certain conditions.


Issues we're tracking for future hotfixes:

 Backlog UI can be viewed during certain scenarios where there's no backlog to read.
 Settings adjustments made on the title screen aren't always reflected in the settings menu viewed in-game on the phone (Display issue only, values are preserved).
 Certain textures in the unlockable concept art gallery appearing unintentionally low-res on certain graphical quality settings.


Improvements and Quality of Life features we're looking into for future patches:

 Additional of target framerate to Settings menu for reducing power consumption on Steam Deck and lower-end setups.
 Additional keyboard shortcuts for navigating to Evidence, Profiles, Settings, etc.
 More robust support for Steam Deck and other controller setups.
 Reduced memory consumption in-game and on start up.
 Improved performance and frame rate stability.


Thank you all for playing and enjoying "of the Devil"! 

Note that you can join our Discord to report bugs and get notifications of any game updates or social media posts, depending on your preference.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.03
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/1632e59fbc9752b70a230f7562611fbdc717ae05.gif

Our latest hotfix is here! This update includes the following changes and fixes:

Gameplay:

 Players can now pause to review evidence in between looping dialogue for Objection segments. When the camera switches back to Morgan from the witness stand, take all the time you need to check things over.
 Choice Cards now fan back out after placing one down on the Timeline grid.
 Fixed an issue where the Hide function was not working properly after loading a save in-session.
 Fixed an issue where saving and loading repeatedly during investigation segments could lead to possible softlocks.
 Fixed an issue where fast-forwarding through repeated Wager choices could lead to possible softlocks.
 Fixed an issue where the wrong count for a evidence gathered in an episode could be displayed (Saves made in an episode prior to this patch may still display the wrong value. Note that this is a display issue only, and doesn't affect what unlocks you earn in the Bonus section).


Scripting:

 Fixed an issue where characters could appear at the wrong scale if a certain specific script pattern was executed.
 Addressed a variety of grammar and spelling errors.


UI and Display:

 Fixed an issue where the Quickbar could become stuck on screen prior to the main menu.
 Corrected how certain text printers display themselves in specific ultrawide aspect ratios.
 Fixed an issue where the incorrect song title would appear in the Now Playing UI.
 Adjusted text and shader defaults to improve readability for choice cards.
 Slightly increased the minimum text display wait time players could set while in Auto mode.
 Fixed an issue where the incorrect "Speaker" names could appear in the backlog.


Issues we're tracking for future hotfixes:

 "Black" phone case color defaulting to "white" upon starting a new game session.
 Scene introductory "Typewriter" text not finishing before Auto mode progresses to the next line at certain low Auto wait-times.
 Scrolling text on the screens in the courtroom failing to animate under certain conditions.


Improvements and Quality of Life features we're pursuing for future patches:

 Additional keyboard shortcuts for navigating to Evidence, Profiles, Settings, etc.
 More robust support for Steam Deck and other controller setups.
 Reduced memory consumption in-game and on start up.
 Improved performance and frame rate stability.


Thank you all for playing and enjoying "of the Devil"! 

Note that you can join our Discord to report bugs and get notifications of any game updates or social media posts, depending on your preference.

notes.title: Hotfix for 1.0
notes.notes:
Our first hotfix is here! We appreciate all your bug reports in our discord and on the steam forums. For this update, we prioritized issues that were impossible to miss, but know that we're taking a look at every item you all bring to our attention.

Items addressed in this hotfix include:

 Characters appearing at the wrong scale in certain scenarios
 Demo players' bonus scenarios and concept art for episode 0 not unlocking properly
 Certain UI elements during courtroom gameplay not changing their visibility correctly
 Typos and grammar fixes


Thank you again for playing, and please continue to enjoy "of the Devil"!
